etymarab.kok_maddesi: Back to library EtymArab ZNǦR زنجر BP – • HDAL • © SG | 15Feb2021 √ZNǦR “root” ▪ ZNǦR_1 ‘verdigris’ ↗ zinǧār . – Cf. also ↗ zunǧufr ‘cinnabar’ ▪ ZNǦR_2 ‘to flip, snap (with the fingers)’ ↗ zanǧara ▪ ZNǦR_3 ‘chain’ ↗ zinǧīr ▪ … – ▪ DRS #ZNGR- 1 Syr Mand zangārā ‘rouille’, Ar zinǧār ‘rouille, vert-de-gris’. - 2 Ar zanǧara ‘claquer des doigts’, zinǧīr ‘chiquenaude’. - 3 Te zəngərgər ‘bariolé’, Amh zänäggʷärä ‘être bariolé’, Gur zəngdärdär : vêtement multicolore. - 4 Te zəngər ‘famille’. - 5 Tña zängar ‘maigre, aux longues jambes’. - 6 Amh zəngäro , ǧənǧäro , Arg ǧinǧäro , Gaf ǧənǧərä , Har zagäru , Gur zangärä ‘babouin’. - 7 Gaf azänäggärä ‘descendre’. - 8 nSyr zanǧil , Ar zinǧīr ‘chaîne’, Te ǧängär ‘entrave pour les pieds’, Tña ǧanǧär ‘chaîne de fer’, Amh zanǧär ‘cangue, carcan’. - 9 nSyr zangūrē ‘sonner’. - 10 Amh zängərir ‘vase en terre’, Tña zəngərir ‘bonbonne, cruche’. ▪ ZNǦR_1 (≙ DRS #ZNGR-1): from Pers or the same source as the corresponding Pers word, cf. ↗ zinǧār . ▪ ZNǦR_2 (≙ DRS #ZNGR-2): DRS reports the opinion of ClassAr lexicographers (as in Lane) that the word is a loan, but does not give further details. ▪ ZNǦR_3 (≙ DRS #ZNGR-8): from Pers, GNDR GNZR ▪ Metathetical variant: ↗ǦNZR. ▪ –. But cf. ↗ zunǧufr . – Sources ; meta ; gram ; engl ; conc ; hist ; cogn ; disc ; west ; deriv ;
